text:
Jasmin Ortega: hey everyone, day 1! quick access questions: who owns staging API keys, container-registry access, and the Okta group for devs? onboarding doc lists teams but not the single voice to ping.
Leo Park: welcome Jasmin :wave: Staging API keys and registry perms are Platform/Infra. Okta groups are managed by People Ops but Platform syncs service accounts. If you need a key for a short experiment, Platform can issue a timeboxed key.
Jasmin Ortega: thanks. what's the fast path if i need a key to run integration tests before EOD?
Gabe Martin: fast path: 1) open an INFRA ticket with exact scope and justification, 2) ping #eng-infra with ticket link and tag "urgent", 3) include your manager for audit. Oncall can approve <=4h keys.
Jasmin Ortega: got it. where's the ticket tracker? i couldn't find it in the handbook.
Leo Park: internal tracker is at https://internal.redwood/tracker (handbook has direct link under "Infra Requests"). we also prefer PRs for owner updates so audit is clearer.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Okta group changes and long-lived credentials require manager + people-ops approval. Contractors need an additional approval from People Ops.
Jasmin Ortega: who can update CODEOWNERS or OWNERS if they're stale? some repos point to an alias that no longer exists.
Gabe Martin: repo maintainers can PR updates to CODEOWNERS/OWNERS. If the listed owner is unresponsive for >72h and it's blocking, file an issue and tag eng-oncall; Platform can set a temporary owner for critical infra. Always include the proposed contact in the PR.
Jasmin Ortega: example: i need access to the staging registry `gcr.io/redwood-staging` but registry returns 403. any tips to troubleshoot before opening a ticket?
Leo Park: try `gcloud auth print-identity-token` + `gcloud auth configure-docker` locally to ensure your creds are loaded. Check your Okta groups in the SSO portal — registry access is gated by the `devs-registry` group. If you still get 403, paste the `gcloud` debug output in the ticket.
Jasmin Ortega: awesome, i'll try that. one more: if the owner is OOO and i need an emergency change to a route quota for a demo, who signs off?
Gabe Martin: emergency flow: ping #eng-oncall and page the oncall. Oncall + Platform can approve timeboxed quota bumps. For anything customer-impacting, escalate to your manager and the Eng manager. Keep a rollback plan in the ticket.
infra-bot: Ticket INFRA-4320 created by Gabe Martin: "short-lived registry access + staging key for jasmin.ortega@redwood-infer.com"  assignee: platform-oncall  status: open
Jasmin Ortega: thanks all, super helpful. i'll attach my debug output to INFRA-4320 and add my manager. saving this thread for other new hires. :sparkles:
Leo Park: welcome aboard Jasmin! DM me if you want a quick runthrough of the owners map.
Gabe Martin: +1, happy to walk through the PR pattern for updating OWNERS.
